summary: Exact concurrency enumeration found fractured snapshots in 10/20 legal 3-field schedules and silent lost updates in 4/6 read-modify-write schedules; version/snapshot guarded transactions eliminate the tested anomalies.

actionable_deltas.claycode: Treat snapshot/read-set/write-set/commit-conflict/retry receipts as CC-WP-07/09 runtime ABI and conformance obligations. Preserve language semantics unless implementation yields a real counterexample.
actionable_deltas.unifieddb: Test transaction/effect atomicity, snapshot consistency and replay under concurrent authoritative updates; keep derived epoch-tagged state separable.
actionable_deltas.harness: Add race/replay tests for fractured snapshots, lost updates, stale-state effect commit, serialization retry and crash boundaries.
